{{Quote|Hey Three-Five, check it out: commandos.''"<br />"''If they're anything as good as I hear, they can practically win the war themselves&hellip;|17 and 35, upon spotting Boss|<ref name="SWRC" />}}
[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] '''17''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], they and fellow [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Three-Five]] fought alongside [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]] and two other [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] in defending a barricade against Separatist [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. Once the advancing [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were defeated, the surviving clones pushed through to a gun emplacement.

==Biography==
[[Cloning/Legends|Decanted]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Enc" /> 17 was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] clone of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> They served as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a separatist group that attempted to secede from the Republic.<ref name="SWRC" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> 17 was deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where they fought in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle]] of the Clone Wars.<ref name="SWRC" />

On Geonosis, 17 and fellow [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Three-Five]] greeted the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]]. Trooper 17 pointed out Boss to their companion, who responded by praising the highly-skilled [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], remarking that they could defeat the Separatist forces alone. The trio then joined two other clone troopers in defending a barricade from Confederate [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] blew through a wall to avoid the barricade, [[Death/Legends|killing]] one of the troopers. Despite the casualty, Boss, 17, 35, and the other surviving [[Unidentified clone trooper (Geonosis)|clone]] defeated the attacking droids, pushing them back to a Separatist gun emplacement.<ref name="SWRC" />

==Personality and traits==
A clone of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter Jango Fett,<ref name="DB" /> 17 stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall like all clone troopers<ref name="Enc" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Equipment==
Like many clones during the opening stages of the Clone Wars, 17 wore white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]]<ref name="SWRC" /><ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> and was armed with a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]].<ref name="SWRC" /><ref name="ROTSVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Trooper 17 appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'',<ref name="SWRC" /> released by [[LucasArts]] in [[2005]].<ref name="Amazon">{{InsiderCite|Special Edition 2022|Sith Unseen: A Retrospective}}</ref> The character was voiced by [[Roger Jackson]].<ref name="SWRC" />
